Absolutely! It can be a lot to take in when you're new, so let me break down some of our main product options for you:

Fresh Frozen Meals: These are our daily meals, made with human-grade ingredients and gently cooked. They are kept frozen and need to be thawed before serving. You can find more about them here.
Pantry Fresh Meals: These are convenient, shelf-stable meals that come in Tetra Pak packaging. They don't require refrigeration until opened and can be stored for up to two years. They're great for travel or as a backup! You can explore them here.
Vet Support Diets: These are specialized diets formulated by our veterinary team to help manage specific health conditions. You can learn more about them here.
Custom Diets: If your dog has unique dietary needs, allergies, or digestive issues, our Nutrition Consultants can help create a custom meal plan tailored just for them. More information is available here.
Variety Packs: These are a great way to introduce your dog to different recipes and find out what they love! We have options like the Pantry Fresh Sampler Variety Box or other variety packs.
DIY Nutrient Blends: For those who prefer to cook their dog's food at home, we offer nutrient blends to ensure the homemade meals are nutritionally complete and balanced. You can find these here.
We also offer a range of Supplements and Treats to complement your dog's diet.

I hope this gives you a clearer picture of our main offerings!
